description.content: Full HustleHub+ Part 2 API collection: auth, gigs, bookings, transactions, income, and admin. Run top-to-bottom (Newman respects request order) - later requests depend on variables captured by earlier ones. Requires a running server with a connected MongoDB database (real Atlas or otherwise). The Admin folder requires an existing admin account matching the adminEmail/adminPassword environment variables (see the environment file notes).
